major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown for energy regeneration and attack speed.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown as an energy builder and damage burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use when you have good Roll the Bones buffs to extend their duration.

major_cooldowns.name: Ghostly Strike
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to increase damage taken by the target.

major_cooldowns.name: Between the Eyes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown with max combo points for damage and crit buff.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to clear and immune magic effects.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Use preemptively to reduce incoming AoE damage.

rules.description: Ghostly Strike before Between the Eyes
rules.action: Ensure Ghostly Strike is active before pressing Between the Eyes.
Use Dispatch or Between the Eyes before overcapping combo points.

source_summary: Outlaw Rogue relies on high APM, using minor cooldowns like Blade Rush and Between the Eyes strictly on cooldown. Roll the Bones RNG management and non-stop combo point generation/spending drive the rotation.
